rule: No completed learning action can increase recommendation confidence until a quality completion receipt shows who closed it, what proof changed, which gate passed, what rollback remains, and which confidence update is allowed.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or receipt without visible proof can reach recommendation weights in phase one.
receipt_principles: Convert completed learning actions into visible receipts before confidence moves.
Attach each receipt to the source learning action queue event.
Show owner, approver, proof delta, completion gate, confidence decision, rollback state, and blocked payment route.
Keep held or incomplete actions from increasing recommendation weight.
Preserve rollback instructions after completion so a bad update can be reversed.
Separate proof improvements from payment-custody routes.
Require a receipt trail before sharing improvement signals across organizations.

role_receipts.rollback_state: restore prior rank if proof is disputed
restore prior visibility if proof expires
restore prior market queue if response drops

acceptance: Marketplace shows Quality Completion Receipts after the Learning Action Queue.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show receipt event, completed action, approver, proof delta, completion gate, confidence decision, rollback state, and blocked route.
Copy output explains the source action, completion receipt, proof delta, confidence decision, rollback, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v175 Quality Completion Receipts contract after the Learning Action Queue contract.
Docs include receipt states, receipt routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required receipt fields.
Static check fails if the receipt UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No recommendation confidence lift can apply without a visible completion receipt or explicit hold in phase one.
